mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SITE_BASIC_STNG ( STNG_ID, SITE_TTL, HMPG_ADDR, MNGR_EML_ADDR, EDNST_NM, EDNST_ADDR, EDNST_TELNO, LOGO_FILE_ID, FAVICON_FILE_ID, FTR_CN, REG_DT, RGTR, MDFCN_DT, MDTR ) VALUES ( #{stngId}, #{siteTtl}, #{hmpgAddr}, #{mngrEmlAddr}, #{ednstNm}, #{ednstAddr}, #{ednstTelno}, #{logoFileId}, #{faviconFileId}, #{ftrCn}, NOW(), #{rgtr}, NOW(), #{mdtr} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SITE_TTL = VALUES(SITE_TTL), HMPG_ADDR = VALUES(HMPG_ADDR), MNGR_EML_ADDR = VALUES(MNGR_EML_ADDR), EDNST_NM = VALUES(EDNST_NM), EDNST_ADDR = VALUES(EDNST_ADDR), EDNST_TELNO = VALUES(EDNST_TELNO), LOGO_FILE_ID = VALUES(LOGO_FILE_ID), FAVICON_FILE_ID = VALUES(FAVICON_FILE_ID), FTR_CN = VALUES(FTR_CN), MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDTR = VALUES(MDTR)
